title: How to Build a Marketplace App with AI: Complete Guide 2026
summary: A marketplace connects buyers and sellers. Learn the 7 core features, the architecture, and how to build your two-sided marketplace with AI — database, auth, and hosting included.
body_markdown: The core functionality — dual accounts, listings, search, Stripe Connect payments, and reviews — typically takes a weekend of prompting and iteration. A simple two-sided marketplace can be live in 2-3 days. More complex logic (custom matching, escrow flows, complex fee structures) takes longer depending on iteration time.
